latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Profile Scraper for ScrapeClaw.

- Discover and scrape TikTok profiles directly from your browser with simulated human behavior and stealth techniques.
- Two-phase workflow: profile discovery (by location/category) and full browser profile scraping.
- Automatically filters out private, low-follower, empty, or previously scraped accounts.
- Exports profile data to JSON/CSV with thumbnail downloads and full engagement stats.
- Supports auto-resume, residential proxies (4 providers), and flexible configuration for advanced users.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and detailed guidance for proxy integration.
